subject: English
passage: Tiny hooks called barbules are found along the branches of bird feathers. These barbules interlock with neighboring barbules to create a tight seal. ______ birds are able to trap air and maintain their body temperature even in cold conditions.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. "As a result" logically signals that the claim in this sentence—that birds can trap air and maintain body temperature—is because of the previous information about the interlocking properties of birds' barbules.
